title: 2023 ACC/AHA/ACCP/HRS Guideline for Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation
summary: Use CHA2DS2-VASc score to assess stroke risk. DOACs preferred over warfarin.

title: 2017 ACC/AHA Guideline for High Blood Pressure in Adults
summary: Target BP <130/80 for most adults. First-line: thiazide, ACEi, ARB, CCB.

title: Standards of Care in Diabetes - 2024
summary: A1c target <7% for most adults. Metformin first-line.

title: Screening for Colorectal Cancer
summary: Screen adults 45-75. Colonoscopy every 10 years or FIT annually.
